title: From revenue to profit for the year
caption: Each line takes something away: cost of sales gives gross profit, expenses give operating profit, interest gives profit before tax and tax gives profit for the year. Only £52,500 of every £500,000 of sales is left.
alt: Waterfall from revenue £500,000 down to profit for the year £52,500 through cost of sales, operating expenses, finance costs and tax.
description: Cost of sales of £300,000 leaves gross profit of £200,000.
Operating expenses of £120,000 leave operating profit of £80,000.
Finance costs of £10,000 leave profit before tax of £70,000.
Tax of £17,500 (25%) leaves profit for the year of £52,500.

relations.name: revenue − cost of sales = gross profit
tax is 25% of profit before tax
profit for the year is 10.5% of revenue
